
{{alias}}( x )
    Returns a boolean indicating if the sign bit is on (true) or off (false).

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: integer
        Signed 32-bit integer.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating if sign bit is on or off.

    Examples
    --------
    > var bool = {{alias}}( 4 )
    false
    > bool = {{alias}}( -4 )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( 0 )
    false
    > bool = {{alias}}( -0 )
    false

    See Also
    --------
